tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company was entitled to excise duty incentives for the assessment years 2006-07 to 2015-16 for its Gagal plant located in the state of Himachal Pradesh. ACC has been contending that the said incentives are in the nature of capital receipts and hence not liable to income tax. However, the Income tax department had consistently denied the position and considered these incentives as a taxable receipt. Post receipt of favourable orders from ITAT, Mumbai, the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) in subsequent years have also passed the orders in favour of the company. Consequently, the Revenue Authorities have also passed necessary order giving effect to ITAT Orders and consequential refunds have also been granted. Accordingly. the management has assessed the risk to be remote and reduced the contingent liability for this matter to nil.

The company has received Assessment Order for the FY 2019-20 demanding Rs. 102.45 crores towards certain disallowances. The company had filed appeal against the said order which is pending for disposal.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹7,146.18 Cr, net profit ₹238.3 Cr (-68.3% YoY).
ACC reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹7,146 Cr and net profit of ₹238 Cr, achieving record annual sales volume.
ACC Limited shared the audio recording link for its Analysts/Investors Call on Audited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) for Q4FY26 and FY26 on May 4, 2026.
Ambuja Cements Limited, on behalf of ACC Limited’s promoters, declared no new encumbrances on ACC shares for FY2026 under SEBI’s takeover rules.
ACC Limited published its Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report for FY 2025-26 on May 30, 2026.
ACC received 'no adverse observations' from BSE and 'no objection' from NSE for its amalgamation scheme with Ambuja Cements.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹5,808 Cr, net profit ₹147 Cr (-60.8% YoY).
ACC reported Q1FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹5,808 Cr and PAT of ₹147 Cr
On July 29, 2026, ACC received an NCLT order to hold a shareholder meeting on September 29, 2026, for its amalgamation into Ambuja Cements.
ACC published the transcript of its Q1FY27 earnings conference call held on July 28, 2026.
On August 5, 2026, ACC informed the exchange about receiving a SEBI administrative warning letter regarding historical Structured Digital Database compliance.
ACC convened the NCLT-ordered equity shareholders meeting for September 29, 2026, regarding its amalgamation into Ambuja Cements.
On September 29, 2026, ACC Limited equity shareholders approved the scheme of amalgamation with Ambuja Cements Limited.
On September 30, 2026, ACC Limited announced the commissioning of a 2.4 MTPA greenfield grinding unit in Uttar Pradesh and a subsidiary's 1 MTPA incremental capacity blending unit in Maharashtra.

ACC Limited’s Board of Directors will approve unaudited Q1 & H1FY27 results on October 27, 2026, with investor call on October 29, 2026, at 04:30 PM IST led by Vinod Bahety, Rohit Soni, and Deepak Balwani.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹5,689 Cr, net profit ₹93 Cr (-91.7% YoY).
ACC posted Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹5,689 Cr with operating EBITDA of ₹401 Cr, commissioned 3.4 MTPA capacity, and advanced its Ambuja merger to the NCLT.
